properties.name: v0.19.0 — the planning axis runs forward: planned epochs, the satisfaction schedule, and the arrival delta
properties.notes:
Cut 2026-07-31. A MINOR bump that LOCKS OLDER REFLOW2 OUT: SCHEDULED_FOR takes the schema from 56 edge types to 57 and that moves the stamp, so a design written by this version is refused by anything earlier (BL-19/BL-94) — upgrade every machine that touches a shared graph, together. Node types hold at 28 and the dynograph-foundation pin stays at v0.12.0, so there is no slow first build. Upgrade note: docs/upgrading-to-v0.19.0.md.

THE PLANNING AXIS RUNS FORWARD. plan_epoch creates a point that has NOT happened, set_epoch_status moves it to arrived, and schedule_for hangs work off it as SCHEDULED_FOR carrying modality expected|required. arrival_delta then answers Anthony's question in his words — 'what didn't we achieve that we were supposed to in increment 10?' — with five outcomes, the fifth (outstanding) being the case the original four assumed away: nobody touched it and it did not happen. The baseline is the target's FIRST snapshot, because the last would measure only the most recent replan and the slip would vanish from the report meant to show it. Nothing about the outcome is stored; delivery stays computed from the golden thread.

THE DESIGN CAN NOW HOLD WHAT IT POINTS AT. content_put / content_get / content_exists / content_manifest — a content-addressed store, COMMITTED to the repo, for what INFORMED the design as against what it produced. Hand-rolled in the core, zero new crates compiled. The manifest is DERIVED from the graph and never stored, because a stored manifest would be a second source of truth able to drift. What bounds the store is WHAT gets stored, measured rather than assumed: 29 session transcripts came to 115.8 MB against 81 MB for the entire .git history, which inverted dec:content-manifest's assumption that images were the risk — so the control is transcripts-by-exception, not a size cap.

AND THE CUT TRIGGER STOPPED BEING VACUOUSLY TRUE. ready_to_cut now demands at least one required obligation as well as an empty miss list; an increment promising nothing used to read as ready, which is the empty-release failure dec:release-trigger was chosen to prevent arriving through its own back door.

MANIFEST: 151 INCLUDES — 98 artifacts and 53 components. THE FIRST CUT TO FREEZE as_checksum ON EVERY ARTIFACT, so this release's manifest cannot quietly rewrite itself when a baseline later moves; the nine prior cuts recorded nulls. New this release: art:content (the store), art:content-test (12 cases, registered here because every sibling core test file already was and this one was missed), art:stateless-seat-probe, and art:upgrading-v0190. Every frozen hash was verified against the file on disk after export.

epoch:v0190 at sequence 240, preceded by epoch:arrival-delta. Verified by CI on the same runners that build the release binaries.
